title: Approve the proposed split
summary: The human gate for a bundled goal, research request or multi-part question that the kernel offers to split. Two samples: a jev_none goal (reject ends the run blocked and records the capability gap) and a bundled_accepted goal of seven parts, where five are offered and two are listed read-only as not covered, ask again (reject keeps it whole). Shows each part with its verbatim span, dependencies and capability, one dropped proposal, and the answers: approve, edit, pick a subset, reject. Reject has three outcomes by trigger: jev_none ends the run blocked; ambiguous falls back to today's clarification question (run waiting_human); bundled_accepted or a mid-run item is kept whole and goes ahead as one.

provenance.note: Drafted from leafcutter/decisions Decomposition records; styled from the Atlas tokens via docs/ui-context.md (globals.css, tailwind.config.ts, layout.tsx, kit.tsx).
